plugin.name: Hi, welcome to PIXL Renderer
plugin.description:
Skyrim, with more of what makes Skyrim feel like Skyrim.
PIXL brings lighting, materials, water, weather, world detail, camera tools and image reconstruction together in one DirectX 11 renderer.
Install with Vortex, MO2, or by extracting into the game Data folder. Launch through SKSE. On first launch, complete Quick Setup and allow shader compilation to finish.

plugin.name: See what's new
plugin.description:
PIXL Renderer 1.0.7 highlights
- Improved camera reconstruction and temporal stability, including Photo Mode and Director Mode. - More consistent Hybrid GI, world-cache updates, emissive lighting and fire response. - Refined water, projected caustic lighting, terrain response, vegetation and atmospheric effects. - Updated materials, camera effects, quality settings and user-facing setup.
Shader compilation happens on first launch. Allow it to finish before evaluating visuals or performance. Existing user settings are preserved.

plugin.name: Install PIXL Renderer 1.0.7
plugin.description:
PIXL Renderer will install with the regular default look and a validated prebuilt shader cache.
After installation, start Skyrim through SKSE. Complete Quick Setup if prompted and let any missing or changed shader permutations compile.
